text:
ashok: FYI - I ran a quick correlation across the last 3 weeks and we have a recurring failure cluster in rack-12. Pattern looks like ECC/Xid followed by soft-fail and then permanent GPU drain on 2-3 nodes. Need a short RCA thread.

maria: saw that this morning.Logs point to repeated Xid 13/41 and then a PCI reset on gpu0, gpu2 in node r12-n3.

lee: sre-bot auto-drained r12-n3 and r12-n7 at 03:12. ops-oncall confirmed temporary capacity hit but traffic rerouted. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: auto-drain triggered: reason="xid_count>5 in 10m" nodes=[r12-n3,r12-n7] actions=[mark_draining,notify_oncall]

ops-oncall: we saw job retries spike ~8% for the rack's shard. Capacity impact is small but visible for low-latency customers.

jon: quick ask - do we have serial/batch mapping for the GPUs in rack-12? vendor told us a vendor lot was shipped in Q4.

vendor-ops: checking. preliminary: several cards in r12 have serial prefix "NX3-76" which maps to the 2024-Q4 lot. We have a support case open.

maria: adding snippet of the node log around the incident:

```
Mar 08 02:58:21 r12-n3 kernel: NVRM: Xid (0006:0a) at 0x4f8b7a
Mar 08 02:58:21 r12-n3 kernel: NVRM: Xid (0006:0a): GPU fault at 0x00000000, reason: ECC Single-bit
Mar 08 02:58:21 r12-n3 kernel: nvidia 0000:02:00.0: GPU is lost: pci error code 0x0001
Mar 08 02:58:22 r12-n3 systemd: nodectl: initiating drain for r12-n3 gpu0,gpu2
```

maria: we also observed elevated GPU temperature spikes (~10C above baseline) immediately before the Xid. Could be a thermal or power delivery issue.

lee: thermal spike on multiple GPUs in same PCI riser points to a rack-level airflow/pdu issue possibly. Did we hit maintenance windows or changed rack airflow?

ops-oncall: no scheduled changes. PDU logs show normal current draw, but airflow sensor in rack-12 shows intermittent dips. I can swing by data center tomorrow for a quick inspection.

ashok: vendor-ops, can you confirm if NX3-76 lot has any outstanding firmware or microcode advisories? Also want a persistence validation plan before we RMA.

vendor-ops: vendor notes one microcode patch that was optional in Dec 2024 for that lot. They recommended flash if customers see Xid 0a/41. We'll provide the patch link and an RMA list if failures persist.

jon: proposing immediate steps: 1) Bench test removed GPUs with stress-ng + ECC test, 2) flash vendor microcode on a canary node, 3) run controlled load for 24h, 4) escalate RMA for confirmed hardware faults.

maria: wrote quick isolation commands to snapshot state and remove GPUs from scheduler: 

```
# snapshot
nvidia-smi -q > /tmp/r12-n3-gpu-snapshot.txt
# drain GPUs from k8s
kubectl annotate node r12-n3 maintenance=true --overwrite
kubectl cordon r12-n3
kubectl drain r12-n3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# hw test (on bench)
stress-ng --gpu 4 --timeout 1h --metrics-brief
```

lee: can we add thermal imaging when ops on-site? might reveal blocked intake or uneven airflow from the rack unit above.

ops-oncall: will bring a thermal camera. Also will log PDU current and inlet temp every 30s while we repro.

ashok: suggested owner & deadlines: maria to lead bench verification (24h canary), vendor-ops to provide microcode + RMA list by EOD, ops-oncall to inspect rack and capture thermal data tomorrow morning. jon to coordinate canary deployment and rollback plan.

maria: started a bench ticket and reserved spare slot for two GPUs removed from r12. Will post results in this thread. :eyes:

vendor-ops: inbound microcode link: https://vendor.example/patches/nx3-76-mc-v1.2. Apply only on canary first. RMA policy: replace after 2 confirmed ECC/Xid events on bench or in-production within 30 days.

jon: for rollback contingency - we should pin the runtime to kernel+driver combo that was stable for the rack last month (5.15 + nvidia-driver 525.89). I'll prepare a test image.

ashok: thanks. Action items summarized:
- maria: bench test and confirm failure reproduction (due +24h)
- vendor-ops: provide microcode/RMA list (EOD)
- ops-oncall: site inspection + thermal logs (tomorrow AM)
- jon: prepare canary image + rollback plan (12h)

lee: logging these into the incident tracker and tagging as "recurring-gpu-faults-rack12". If bench reproduces, we'll plan coordinated RMA to avoid capacity cliffs.

maria: quick note - if bench fails after microcode, escalate warranty. If bench passes after microcode, prioritize investigating rack airflow/power.

ashok: good. keep updates short in this thread. If anything needs immediate routing to customers, ping me and product. :shipit:
